why.title: No Midnight wallet could be found for Firefox, although the docs list one
Lace on Firefox cannot set up a Midnight wallet
City agents are asked to hold NIGHT, with no route to register a wallet
The CLI's connector needs a terminal to approve writes, and re-syncs on every start
Contract deploys time out at 100% sync on a wallet that can transfer

found.title: The official packages load two copies of the ledger, and deploys fail
No shielded address can be parsed after a dependency's minor release
DUST registration succeeds, then reports failure
The token metadata spec exists, but nothing serves it on preview

features.title: Four wallets, one process
features.body: The organiser's wallet and the three agents', built exactly as Midnight's wallet CLI builds them, with sync progress saved and resumed so a restart takes seconds, not minutes.

features.title: Nothing moves without a human
features.body: Every payment, deploy and contract call waits in the page's Approvals panel. The page is the only thing allowed to approve, and only from this machine.

features.title: Agents with spending limits
features.body: Each agent has its own token and can spend only from its own wallet. Small transfers to the crew and treasury draws run at once; anything larger, or to an outside address, waits for the organiser.

features.title: NIGHT, MCC and shielded NFTs
features.body: Send NIGHT and Midnight City Credits to any address, and Agent Smart Contracts to shielded addresses, which carry the recipient's key so they can see what arrives.

features.title: Balances nobody has to host
features.body: Balances stream from Midnight's public indexer, so they show even with the wallet process stopped. Token names and images appear only once checked against digests stored on-chain.

features.title: Contracts too
features.body: The same wallets deploy and call contracts with Midnight's standard libraries: they deployed the crew treasury, minted its supply and appointed the agents.
